acquisition_type: VMware powered-on saved-memory snapshot (.vmem with matching metadata), not WinPmem
process_selection: Active target names were checked in windows.pslist. Exited-process residue was checked separately in windows.psscan; scan rows are not treated as active processes.

later_edge_trial_marker_check.method: Post-hoc exact-byte scan of this hash-verified VMware .vmem file, using values recorded independently for the four later Edge trials; this is not the blind renderer parser
later_edge_trial_marker_check.scope: Absence of these exact byte sequences in the saved snapshot file, not proof of physically clean RAM or erasure after the later trials

interpretation: The snapshot is a repeatable, signed-in, client-stopped reset point. It is not evidence of a never-used browser or physically clean RAM. Later synthetic prompts were new relative to this reset point.
